plate.narration: The Saltrot flats lie under a thin wash of water. Reeds lean over the channels. On one muddy bank, a patch of snow shines white in the mild coastal light.

goal.text: Bring the stranded snowhorn goat home before the opening closes.

voiceGuide.tone: Warm, curious and practical. Short sentences. Show the consequence of each plan. Nobody dies.

arrival.narration: On the Saltrot mudflats, an opening in the air blinks away and comes back. Through it lies snow. A snowhorn goat stands belly-deep in mud beside it, chewing a reed with great disappointment. Your Skupper guide from the Saltrot bank waves her fins in greeting, then points to the rising tide. "Bring that goat home before the opening closes. I can find firm mud. I cannot make a goat like it."

choices.label: Go on

observe.narration: Snow, empty sky, snow again. The opening returns narrower each time. Watch its changing-view pattern from this marker. The guide rests her fins on firm shells. "We need a whole landing, not just a glimpse of breakfast."

choices.label: Continue

observe_pattern.narration: Watch the view through the opening as it changes, then echo the pattern. It is an observation of these blinks, not a promise that the next will match.

interaction.cue: Watch the opening pattern, then echo it.

onSuccess.narration: You distinguish a whole landing from the narrowing glimpses.

onFailure.narration: One blink escaped your count. The guide will call the clear views while your party handles the rescue.

onAssisted.narration: One blink escaped your count. The guide will call the clear views while your party handles the rescue.

sound.narration: Your Listening Chime is the one the glacier travelers gave you. Its sour note warns that a gap is not ready; an echo answers along an open way back. Wait for the whole snowy landing before testing from this bank.

interaction.cue: Test while the whole-landing interval is clear.

onSuccess.narration: An echo answers from the snow side. The guide marks the whole-view limit.

onFailure.narration: The note sounds sour during a narrow blink. You stay on the bank while the guide waits for the full view and checks its echo.

onAssisted.narration: An echo answers from the snow side. The guide marks the whole-view limit.

ground.narration: The short mud dip needs your stiff mat laid underfoot. That gets you to the goat directly, but the mat must stay on the approach; the goat will need its sling to cross. The longer shell-bank curve keeps the stiff mat free for a low ramp later. Which route will you prepare?

choices.label: Lay the stiff mat over the short dip
Take the longer shell banks and keep the mat

lay_mat.narration: Pass the stiff mat along the dry edge and lay it over the short dip. The guide tests it before anyone moves the goat. Her separate soft signal mat stays rolled in her bag.

interaction.cue: Pass the stiff approach mat to the guide.

onSuccess.narration: The short approach is supported. The stiff mat must stay underfoot until the rescue is finished.

onFailure.narration: The short approach is supported. The stiff mat must stay underfoot until the rescue is finished.

onAssisted.narration: The short approach is supported. The stiff mat must stay underfoot until the rescue is finished.

shell_route.narration: Share the guide's shell-bank clues to mark a longer dry curve. The stiff mat rides along rolled up; you have kept it for the crossing.

interaction.cue: Mark the shell-bank approach from the guide's pool.
clues: The reed clump is the first stop beside the pool.
The white shell bank lies between the reeds and the notched ridge.
The notched shell ridge is nearest the goat.

onSuccess.narration: Your shell-bank route keeps the stiff mat free.

onFailure.narration: The guide corrects one wet turn from her pool. The longer dry curve is marked without using the mat.

onAssisted.narration: Your shell-bank route keeps the stiff mat free.

shell_markers.narration: Pass the little shell markers along the longer curve so everyone can follow it back. The goat watches the bag as if the shells might be lunch.

interaction.cue: Pass the route markers along the shell banks.

onSuccess.narration: The longer return curve is marked and the stiff mat is still free.

onFailure.narration: The longer return curve is marked and the stiff mat is still free.

onAssisted.narration: The longer return curve is marked and the stiff mat is still free.

approach.narration: The goat tries to eat the rescue line. Its front hooves are free, but the back pair are stuck. Your party can settle it with a quiet greeting, or let a songkeeper lead the calming hum while everyone readies the sling.

choices.label: Give the goat a calm greeting
Let our songkeeper lead the calming hum

calm_goat.narration: Choose how to greet the goat without pulling the line from its mouth. It needs a familiar calm moment before the sling goes under.

interaction.cue: Help the goat settle.

options.label: Offer a dry reed instead
options.reaction: The goat accepts the reed and releases your line.

options.label: Hold a quiet open palm
options.reaction: The goat noses your hand, then stops chewing the rope.

options.label: Hum a small steady greeting
options.reaction: The goat listens. The guide frees the end of the line.

onSuccess.narration: The goat stands quietly while the guide brings the broad sling.

onFailure.narration: The goat stands quietly while the guide brings the broad sling.

onAssisted.narration: The goat stands quietly while the guide brings the broad sling.

songkeeper_calm.narration: Your songkeeper holds a low, steady hum. The goat drops the line to listen. The rest of the team can ready the sling without first doing the greeting round. "A very useful opinion," says the guide. "From the goat, I mean."

choices.label: Continue

sling.narration: The broad reed sling spreads the pull under the goat. Hold its sides while the guide slides the soft middle beneath it. Solo heroes can use her fixed poles as supports.

interaction.cue: Support the broad sling while the guide slides it under.

onSuccess.narration: The sling is in place. The mud still grips the back hooves.

onFailure.narration: The sling is in place. The mud still grips the back hooves.

onAssisted.narration: The sling is in place. The mud still grips the back hooves.

lift.narration: The mud holds the goat like two stubborn boots. Loosen the packed rim before lifting, or ask a bigfoot to break that rim beside the hoof holes. The sling still needs a gentle, level lift either way.

choices.label: Loosen the packed mud around the hooves
Have our bigfoot break the packed rim

loosen_mud.narration: Work the small flat tool beside a hoof when the goat is resting its weight on the sling. No straight-up tugging. The mud makes a rude sucking noise.

interaction.cue: Loosen the packed rim in the supported interval.

onSuccess.narration: The packed rim comes loose around both back hooves.

onFailure.narration: The packed rim holds. The guide works a little reed water around the edge while you keep the sling ready.

onAssisted.narration: The packed rim comes loose around both back hooves.

mud_recovery.narration: Pass the guide's cup of shallow water along the firm edge. She softens the packed rim, keeping the goat supported instead of pulling harder.

interaction.cue: Pass the small cup along the firm edge.

onSuccess.narration: The softened mud releases its grip. The guide puts the cup away.

onFailure.narration: The softened mud releases its grip. The guide puts the cup away.

onAssisted.narration: The softened mud releases its grip. The guide puts the cup away.

bigfoot_rim.narration: Your bigfoot breaks the packed rim beside the hoof holes. The guide shields the goat's legs with the broad sling. That clears the loosening job; now lift evenly rather than harder.

choices.label: Continue

lift_balance.narration: Settle the sling level and let the goat step onto the shell bank. It lifts one back hoof, then the other, with a very surprised snort.

interaction.cue: Level the sling before helping the goat step free.

onSuccess.narration: Both back hooves come free. The goat stands on the marked shell bank.

onFailure.narration: Both back hooves come free. The goat stands on the marked shell bank.

onAssisted.narration: Both back hooves come free. The goat stands on the marked shell bank.

dry_patch.narration: The goat is out, but cold mud clings to one stiff leg. Dry and warm it before the crossing, or let a unicorn use Mend on the strain. A more comfortable leg gives the goat a wider easy-stepping interval later.

choices.label: Dry the cold leg and shelter the goat
Let our unicorn Mend the strained leg

warm_goat.narration: Choose a small comfort while the guide rubs the leg dry. The goat has decided the lunch basket is the most reassuring part of your team.

interaction.cue: Help the freed goat warm up.

options.label: Hold the soft mat against the wind
options.reaction: The goat stops shivering behind the mat.

options.label: Brush loose mud from the coat
options.reaction: Mud drops away. The goat shakes one ear at you.

options.label: Offer another dry reed
options.reaction: The goat chews instead of investigating the sling.

onSuccess.narration: The cold leg is dry and ready for the herder's help.

onFailure.narration: The cold leg is dry and ready for the herder's help.

onAssisted.narration: The cold leg is dry and ready for the herder's help.

mended_goat.narration: Your unicorn uses a gift called Mend on the strained leg. The goat puts its hoof down more comfortably. The guide checks it, then points out the longer easy-stepping moment your team can use for a supported crossing.

choices.label: Continue

rest.narration: The guide leads you onto a raised shell bank while the goat waits safely in its sling. She opens her waterproof lunch basket: warm kelp cakes and a flask of broth. Steam curls over the shells. There is time to eat before the next crossing.

choices.label: Rest, then find the snowy landing
Rest while watching the next clear view

glimpse.narration: Through a full clear blink, a yeti herder waves from the snow. She recognizes the goat from her herd: an adult, not the kid you helped before. She clears a landing while your guide keeps everyone on the flats. The herder will receive the goat; your party will not cross.

choices.label: Continue

signal.narration: The snowy landing is clear. Agree how both banks will know to stop: show the guide's soft signal mat, or repeat a quiet sound along the waiting line. The goat offers a bleat. "Terrible signal," says the guide. "Excellent goat."

choices.label: Watch and repeat the mat signals
Pass the quiet calls between the banks

signal_visual.narration: The herder demonstrates the soft-mat calls. Watch their changing pattern, then echo it. Nobody moves the goat while the team is learning.

interaction.cue: Watch the mat-signal pattern, then echo it.

onSuccess.narration: Your team recognizes the herder's calls and can use a wider checked-signal interval.

onFailure.narration: Your guide takes over the calls. Use her supported crossing plan instead of claiming your team checked the whole pattern.

onAssisted.narration: Your guide takes over the calls. Use her supported crossing plan instead of claiming your team checked the whole pattern.

signal_relay.narration: Pass the herder's quiet stop call along your bank. The guide repeats it back before any goat moves. This takes a full relay now and leaves the guide leading the final crossing.

interaction.cue: Pass the stop call to the next helper.

onSuccess.narration: The quiet call reaches both banks. Your guide will lead the supported final handover.

onFailure.narration: The quiet call reaches both banks. Your guide will lead the supported final handover.

onAssisted.narration: The quiet call reaches both banks. Your guide will lead the supported final handover.

crossing.narration: The goat can follow the sling into the herder's waiting hands. A missed step needs both banks to keep supporting it, and may leave the sling in the snow. If you saved the stiff mat, you can instead level a low ramp, then spend another relay bringing that mat back. Which plan will you play?

choices.label: Guide the goat in its sling
Use our checked mat signals for the sling
Use the mended leg's easier stepping interval
Use our saved stiff mat as a low ramp

crossing_sling.narration: Wait for the whole snowy landing and the herder's ready signal. Guide the goat's front step while she receives the sling. Your heroes remain on the flats.

interaction.cue: Guide the step inside the full-landing interval.

onSuccess.narration: The goat steps onto the snow and the herder takes its weight.

onFailure.narration: The goat hesitates. Both banks keep the sling supported while the herder readies the blanket.

onAssisted.narration: The goat steps onto the snow and the herder takes its weight.

crossing_checked.narration: Wait for the whole snowy landing and the herder's ready signal. Guide the goat's front step while she receives the sling. Your heroes remain on the flats.

interaction.cue: Guide the step inside the full-landing interval.

onSuccess.narration: The goat steps onto the snow and the herder takes its weight.

onFailure.narration: The goat hesitates. Both banks keep the sling supported while the herder readies the blanket.

onAssisted.narration: The goat steps onto the snow and the herder takes its weight.

crossing_mended.narration: Wait for the whole snowy landing and the herder's ready signal. Guide the goat's front step while she receives the sling. Your heroes remain on the flats.

interaction.cue: Guide the step inside the full-landing interval.

onSuccess.narration: The goat steps onto the snow and the herder takes its weight.

onFailure.narration: The goat hesitates. Both banks keep the sling supported while the herder readies the blanket.

onAssisted.narration: The goat steps onto the snow and the herder takes its weight.

crossing_recovery.narration: Hold the stop and the sling steady while the herder draws her blanket toward the herd. She will take the goat fully onto snow. Leave the wet sling with her rather than pulling it back through a narrowing gap.

interaction.cue: Keep the sling supported while the herder receives the goat.
interaction.actionLabel: Let the herder take the weight

onSuccess.narration: The herder has the whole goat on snow. The sling must stay with her.

onFailure.narration: The herder has the whole goat on snow. The sling must stay with her.

onAssisted.narration: The herder has the whole goat on snow. The sling must stay with her.

crossing_ramp.narration: You saved the stiff mat by taking the shell-bank curve. Level it as a low ramp while the herder receives the goat. Your guide keeps the soft signal mat separate.

interaction.cue: Level the stiff mat for the goat's supported step.

onSuccess.narration: The goat reaches the herd. The stiff mat now needs bringing back to your bank.

onFailure.narration: The goat reaches the herd. The stiff mat now needs bringing back to your bank.

onAssisted.narration: The goat reaches the herd. The stiff mat now needs bringing back to your bank.

ramp_return.narration: The herder holds the far end while your team passes the stiff mat back along the flats. This is the extra carrying your ramp plan required.

interaction.cue: Pass the recovered stiff mat back to the guide.

onSuccess.narration: The stiff mat and loose lines are back on the flats.

onFailure.narration: The stiff mat and loose lines are back on the flats.

onAssisted.narration: The stiff mat and loose lines are back on the flats.

crossing_clear.narration: The herder takes the goat onto the snow bank. You pull every loose line back to the flats.

choices.label: Go on

crossing_changed.narration: You hold the stop signal. The herder draws the blanket toward the herd, and the goat follows it fully onto snow before the next blink. The wet sling stays with the herder.

choices.label: Go on

last_blink.narration: The goat is home. Keep the last marker clear while the guide draws in her loose line. A narrow blink shows only snow and the herder's hand, then closes.

interaction.cue: Support the last marker while the guide clears the line.

onSuccess.narration: All the heroes are on the flats when the opening closes.

onFailure.narration: All the heroes are on the flats when the opening closes.

onAssisted.narration: All the heroes are on the flats when the opening closes.

record.narration: The tide smooths the hoof holes. Your guide has a driftwood warning board. A picture of the missing middle can warn against blinking gaps, or a bank drawing can lead travelers to the safe waiting place. Which warning will you leave?

choices.label: Draw the opening with its missing middle
Draw the safe bank and waiting place

warning_picture.narration: You draw the interrupted opening beside the waiting marker. The guide checks that the missing middle can be seen from the shell path.

choices.label: Continue

warning_bank.narration: You draw the firm bank and stopping place. The guide checks its landmarks from the shell path.

choices.label: Continue

credit.narration: The guide asks what the next traveler should know about your rescue. Choose a true part of the teamwork while she finishes the warning.

interaction.cue: Give credit for a checked part of the rescue.

options.label: Name the guide's firm-ground help
options.reaction: The guide taps the shell route with one fin.

options.label: Name the herder's snowy landing
options.reaction: The empty view still has her cleared landing in your notes.

options.label: Name your team's steady sling work
options.reaction: The guide adds a sling beside the route drawing.

onSuccess.narration: The warning shows what helped, without promising the opening will return.

onFailure.narration: The warning shows what helped, without promising the opening will return.

onAssisted.narration: The warning shows what helped, without promising the opening will return.

next.narration: The guide points out a trail to the Bone Yard, a place of old bones where anything taken comes back, and the way back toward the buried bridge. You will choose your destination after leaving the flats. The packs are ready and the warning is in place. Follow the guide back to firm ground.

choices.label: Follow the marked bank to the next route

variants.text: Your picture warning catches a passing fisher. She stops at the missing middle and chooses the marked waiting spot.
A passing fisher follows your safe-bank drawing straight to the waiting spot. The guide nods: the new marker works.

ending.narration: The snowhorn goat is back with its herd. The opening has closed, and the tide smooths away its muddy hoof holes. Your guide checks the warning board. "Wait until you can see the whole crossing." She leads you back along the markers to firm ground. The flats look quiet again. This time, you know what to look for.

variants.text: The sling stayed with the herder. The guide will make another; she will not send anyone back into a closed gap for it.
The short approach used the stiff mat underfoot. You brought it in from the dip after the opening closed.
The longer shell-bank curve kept the stiff mat available for your chosen crossing.
